evidence.note: Flat orthosteric surface typically requires >700 Da macrocycles for sub-100 nM potency.

experiments.design: SPR competition binding and Caco-2 bidirectional efflux

mechanism: Competitive orthosteric blockade of the PCSK9 D374 salt-bridge and hydrophobic patch.
predictions: High polar surface area limiting Caco-2 permeability
statement: Peptidomimetic bicyclic scaffold directly competing with LDLR EGF-A residues N295-C308 on the solvent-exposed PCSK9 catalytic surface.
title: Direct Orthosteric Small-Molecule Mimicry of LDLR EGF-A Ca2+ Loop Across the Flat PCSK9 Beta-Sheet
